synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO forecasted an LOR1 for SA on 29 July 2026 that included the 17:00–22:30 period, and AEMO cancelled that LOR1 forecast before 29 July.

document_statements.quote: PDPASA - Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 1 (LOR1) in the SA Region on 29/07/2026.
AEMO declares a Forecast LOR1 condition under clause 4.8.4(b) of the National Electricity Rules for the SA region for the following Periods:
The forecast capacity reserve requirement is 400 MW.
The minimum capacity reserve available is 379 MW.
PDPASA - Cancellation of the Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 1 (LOR1) in the SA Region on 29/07/2026.
The Forecast LOR1 condition in the SA region advised in AEMO Electricity Market Notice No. 144652 is cancelled at 1345 hrs 28/07/2026.
